Pool depth is thin at 154.54 SOL, so a $20 round trip costs roughly 3-5% in impact and fees, and a further dip of that size wipes out any small bounce. The curve data (bundle share 12.75%, completer share 15.7%) suggests some insider participation, and the launch bot presence fits a coin whose early holders may be distributing into retail. Treat the name as noise, not signal.

Verdict: skip. The structure points to distribution, not an organic recovery.
